name: Edge Case — User Provides Date Without Year
goal: User provides appointment date without year; bot asks for year and combines input.
constraints: User says '15 August', bot prompts for year, user replies with year.

phases.description: User provides date without year; bot asks for year.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot prompts for year, user provides year, bot combines to full date.
